name: orchestra-man-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin for multi-agent code generation and correction across repositories, with shared memory on Cloudflare D1 or local SQLite.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.worker:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply orchestra-man --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.worker:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply orchestra-man --remote -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
